verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents issuing scoped, revocable credentials to agents. An agent gets its own signer key bound to a user-approved permission set (spend cap, allowed counterparties, time window), enforced onchain and revocable at any time. Agent cards are one-time credentials with a fixed allowance, expiry and merchant lock. These are payment and signing credentials, though, not least-privilege platform API keys: the only API-key evidence covers client-side keys with URL whitelisting, with no permission scopes. missing for 10: scoped/permissioned Crossmint API keys issuable per agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
